verdict.rationale: Runpod documents an S3-compatible API for direct file management on network volumes, plus CLI (runpodctl) file transfer between local system and Runpod, SSH access, and no ingress/egress fees for Pods — covering multiple documented transfer paths. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the S3 API's throughput/compatibility and broader cloud-storage sync (e.g., rclone/GDrive) integration beyond docs claims.
